scope: Current branch runtime and coordinator, disposable PostgreSQL database and isolated RisingWave pipeline on Golaberto test server; application release unchanged

localDockerIntegration.detail: Initial run reached coordinator initialization but PostgreSQL entered recovery during source creation. Experimental memory budgets caused RisingWave compactor startup failure and were reverted. Live adoption canary passed against the same RisingWave version.

limitations: No production rollout or performance claim
First upgrade reconstructs pipelines because generated SQL changes
Network blackholes and long retention expiry were not injected
